title: Geyser Redstone Activation
description: Adds Redstone activation to Sulfur Geysers (Vanilla)
body:
![LogoV3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/39769bababf784c8ee995496f4d9df563af422ad.png)
Adds Redstone control for Sulfur Geysers. Power the Magma Block underneath a geyser to keep it active, and remove the signal to turn it off again.
